title: Lylat validated-detections export, version 1
description: A range export of the detection rules that fired, or blocked, against a technique during a published range run. ATT&CK-Navi imports it locally as range-scoped evidence. This is ATT&CK-Navi's own consumer copy, a provisional structural pin; see PROVENANCE.md.

range_build_ref.description: The range build the run was validated against, a git-style short or full hex id. Required once the export carries any rows.

generated_at.description: When the export was produced, RFC 3339 date-time.

rows.description: One row per validated detection against a technique in a mission.

mission_id.description: The mission the detection was validated in. An opaque upper-case id, never a host or path.

id.description: The technique id: T#### / T####.### for ATT&CK, AML.T#### / AML.T####.### for ATLAS.

attack_version.description: The ATT&CK (or ATLAS) version the id was written under, dotted digits.

detection_ref.description: The detection that fired, as <source>:<id>. The id only, never a rule body or query.

coverage_state.description: How far the detection was taken for this technique.

outcome.description: What the detection did when the technique ran.

negative_control.description: The negative control recorded for the run.

validated_at.description: The date the detection was validated, YYYY-MM-DD.

evidence_ref.description: An opaque reference to the run evidence, never a host, path or URL.
